title: 'Tis Pity She's a Whore
writer: John Ford, Alfio Valdarnini, Carlo Carunchio
actors: Charlotte Rampling, Oliver Tobias, Fabio Testi
plot: Annabella marries Soranzo, when she is pregnant by her brother Giovanni. Destiny, and jealousies will expose her past, and Soranzo broods revenge. But he is not alone in that - and death will unite all.
